name: Andrzej Halicki, Matjaž Nemec - Après le § 40 - Am 90
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text: 40 a. Recalls that the InvestEU programme operates with resources stemming from the Union budget and therefore must be subject to the highest standards of transparency, accountability and democratic oversight; stresses that the InvestEU should not be used to finance the ReArm Europe Plan;
